name: Minestrone Morsel #4
description:
A can of minestrone soup that heats itself upon opening. The soup provides optimal nutrition for three hours, ensuring hydration and energy without further consumption.

EFFECT: Self-heating soup that supplies the consumer with hydration and energy for extended periods.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Emits heat upon opening and provides optimal hydration and energy for 3 hours.
TASTE: Rich minestrone with a notable earthy undertone, providing a warm, comforting sensation.
PACKAGING: A small, vibrantly colored can with a peel-off lid labeled in Italian.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-06-21 — edition #4 of the permanent record.
